title: 第2589章 快去救慕以言第2588章 想英雄救美
lines: 没想到就遇上了这样倒霉事！慕念安咬咬牙：“我缠住他们，你回去叫人1
“你怎么缠住？”
慕以言反问，“他们会”后面的话，他说不出口。
慕念安是他这么多年来，小心呵护，细心照料的人，怎么可能让这些人随随便便的就糟蹋了？
“我也害怕你受伤”慕念安喃喃说道，“以言，你在想方设法的保护我的时候，其实，我也在尽我所能的保护你。”
他嘴角一勾，露出笑意。
有她这句话，就够了。
“念安。”
“我数三声，数到三的时候，我冲上去，你就跑。
越快越好，不要耽误，马上去找人来。
听到了吗？”
慕念安答应了，“我会用我最快的速度来救你的慕以言，你要撑住，你也要保护好自己1
“放心。
我学过跆拳道的，你忘记了？”
慕念安当然记得。
爸妈对他们两个的教育很上心，不仅仅是学业方面，艺术特长啊，身体素质啊等等，他们都学习过。
慕以言是有些身手的。
但一个人对付这么多人，而且对面的人手里还有武器有点悬。
咬咬牙，慕念安知道，时间就是生命，只能博一把了0一，二，三——”在慕以言喊出这个数字的时候，他迅速的上前，一脚踢在最前面那个人的胸膛上！而慕念安，也如刚刚商量的那般，转身就跑。
她耳边只有呼呼的风声，还有身后传来的打斗声！这条路，慕念安不是第一次走，以前经常会散散步，闲来无事的时候走一走。
可是今天她怎么感觉这条路，好长，好长。
慕念安此刻脑海里只有一个信念，那就是跑，没命的跑，飞快的跑。
她要救慕以言！打斗声越来越远，惨叫声不时的响起，慕念安不敢去想，那是慕以言的声音，还是那些坏人的就在要拐弯进入另外一条路的时候，慕念安还是忍不住回头了。
她要看一眼。
否则，她如何安心。
她的良心不允许她真的不回头！当慕念安看到身后那一幕时，她的瞳孔都猛然一缩“慕以言1
凄厉的喊声，在夜空中那么的清晰！他已经摔倒在地，手上还握着从对方那里夺过来的铁棒，但对方人多势众，他还是处于劣势了。
慕以言听见她的声音，用尽全身力气喊道，“快跑1
她怎么还是回头了！这一刻，泪水充盈着慕念安的双眼。
在她的世界里，慕以言永远是那么高高在上，矜贵冷傲的人，好像世界上没有什么事情，可以将他打倒，可以让他感到为难。
他是爸妈的骄傲，是慕家的接班人。
但现在，因为她深夜出来散步，惹上一群酒醉鬼，让慕以言为了救她，置身险境那群人朝慕念安的方向追了过来。
content_en:
I didn't expect to encounter such an unfortunate thing! Mu Nian'an gritted his teeth and said, "I'll pester them, you go back and call someone 1
"Why are you entangled? "
Mu Yiyan asked back, "Will they?" He couldn't say the next words.
Mu Nian'an was someone he had carefully protected and cared for over the years. How could he let these people ruin him so casually?
"I'm also afraid that you will get hurt," Mu Nian'an murmured, "Yi Yan, when you are trying every means to protect me, in fact, I am also doing my best to protect you. "
The corner of his mouth curled up into a smile.
Her words were enough.
"Nian'an. "
"Um? "
“I’ll count three, and when I count to three, I’ll rush up to you and you’ll run away.
The sooner the better, don't delay, go find someone right away.
Did you hear that? "
"good. "
Mu Nian'an agreed, "I will use my fastest speed to save your Mu Yiyan, you have to hold on, and you have to protect yourself 1
"Don't worry.
I learned Taekwondo, have you forgotten? "
Of course Mu Nianan remembered it.
Their parents were very concerned about their education, not only in terms of academics, but also in terms of artistic skills, physical fitness, etc., they had studied them all.
Mu Yiyan has some skills.
But it's a bit of a stretch to deal with so many people by one person, and the person opposite has a weapon in his hand.
Gritting his teeth, Mu Nian'an knew that time was life, and he could only win one, one, two, three--" When Mu Yiyan shouted out the number, he quickly stepped forward and kicked the person in front of him in the chest! And Mu Nian'an, as he had just discussed, turned around and ran away.
There was only the whistling of the wind in her ears, and the sound of fighting coming from behind! This was not the first time Mu Nian'an walked this road. He used to take a walk often when he had nothing to do.
But today she felt that this road was so long, so long.
Mu Nian'an only had one belief in his mind at the moment, and that was to run, run with his life, run fast.
She wants to save Mu Yiyan! The sounds of fighting were getting farther and farther, and screams could be heard from time to time. Mu Nian'an didn't dare to think whether it was Mu Yiyan's voice or those of the bad guys. Just when he was about to turn into another road, Mu Nian'an couldn't help but look back.
She wanted to take a look.
Otherwise, how could she feel at ease.
Her conscience does not allow her to really not look back! When Mu Nian'an saw the scene behind her, her pupils suddenly shrank "Mu Yiyan 1
The shrill shouts were so clear in the night sky! He had fallen to the ground, still holding the iron rod he had snatched from the opponent, but he was still at a disadvantage due to the overwhelming number of opponents.
"Run 1
Mu Yiyan heard her voice and shouted with all his strength, "Run 1
Why did she look back? At this moment, tears filled Mu Nian'an's eyes.
In her world, Mu Yiyan was always so aloof, dignified, cold and arrogant, as if nothing in the world could knock him down or make him feel embarrassed.
He is the pride of his parents and the successor of the Mu family.
But now, because she went out for a walk late at night, she got into trouble with a group of drunken men, and Mu Yiyan put himself in danger to save her. The group of people chased in the direction of Mu Nian'an.
title_en: Chapter 2589: Go and save Mu Yiyan Chapter 2588: Want a hero to save the beauty
